summary: This sermon examines John 8:31-59, where believing Jews turn hostile toward Jesus within 27 verses. The central moment is Jesus's declaration 'Before Abraham was, I AM,' identifying himself as Yahweh, the God who revealed himself to Moses. The sermon emphasizes God's consistent character throughout history: inviting His creation out of slavery into freedom.
key_points: Believing Jews quickly move from faith to attempting to stone Jesus
Jesus confronts their stubbornness about needing spiritual freedom from sin
They are deceived by religious identity rather than true relationship with God
Jesus declares 'Before Abraham was, I AM,' claiming equality with Yahweh
God's eternal nature is to invite people from slavery into abundant life
big_idea: God has always been, is, and will always be inviting His creation out of slavery that leads to death and into freedom that leads to life, and Jesus is that same Yahweh in the flesh.
title: Like No Other: "Before Abraham was, I AM"
